authored_fixture.encoder: Pass x/y into the first two of 32 ReLU units; remaining units are zero.
authored_fixture.head: Ordinary scores 0/1 are 2*relu(x/y)-128; remaining ordinary scores are -128; reserved score 8 is -64.
authored_fixture.meaning: Literal expected values check engineering semantics; they are not scientific accuracy, usefulness or business-impact results.

checked_engineering_obligations: All five expected endpoint/encoder/preprocessing/feature/ordered-row identities must match captured values before the first native forward. Row reorder and signed-zero mutations retain denominators but change raw row identity.

An authored width-two encoder performs native float32 affine then ReLU; literal expected hidden features detect missing ReLU. All nine raw head scores participate in lowest-index argmax, including ordinary/reserved ties and reserved-output wins.
Exactly sixteen contiguous 256-row chunks contribute to eight complete 512-row class denominators. Literal expected predictions and counts are asserted independently of the count kernel.
Caller-owned encoder arrays, row bodies, preprocessing and expected bindings can be changed after capture without changing the captured slot or returned binding.
Exceptions, interruption, truncated outputs, nonfinite outputs and incorrect native output dtypes partway through a slot prevent any completed result.
CPU device and disabled-autocast contexts restore on return and unwinding without global numerical setters. Wrong build/precision declarations and observable runtime drift prevent a completed result.
